argv:
set -euo pipefail; source "$1"; rm -rf "{work}/wheelhouse"; mkdir -p "{work}/wheelhouse"; python3 -m pip wheel --no-deps --no-build-isolation --no-index --no-cache-dir -w "{work}/wheelhouse" "{src}"; python3 -c 'import os, pathlib, sys, zipfile
wheelhouse = pathlib.Path(sys.argv[1])
source_root = str(pathlib.Path(sys.argv[2]).resolve()).encode("utf-8")
wheels = sorted(wheelhouse.glob("triton-*.whl"))
if len(wheels) != 1:
    raise SystemExit("expected exactly one Triton wheel")
wheel = wheels[0]
tmp = wheel.with_name(wheel.name + ".tmp")
with zipfile.ZipFile(wheel, "r") as src_zip, zipfile.ZipFile(tmp, "w") as dst_zip:
    for info in src_zip.infolist():
        data = src_zip.read(info.filename)
        if info.filename.endswith(".ll"):
            data = data.replace(source_root, b".")
        dst_zip.writestr(info, data)
os.replace(tmp, wheel)
' "{work}/wheelhouse" "{src}"

set -euo pipefail
env_file="$1"
shift
root="$PWD"
abs_prefix() ( case "$1" in /*) printf "%s\n" "$1" ;; *) printf "%s/%s\n" "$root" "$1" ;; esac )
python="$(abs_prefix "$1")"
shift
python_venv="$(abs_prefix "$1")"
shift
py_pip="$(abs_prefix "$1")"
shift
py_setuptools="$(abs_prefix "$1")"
shift
py_wheel="$(abs_prefix "$1")"
shift
py_filelock="$(abs_prefix "$1")"
shift
py_lit="$(abs_prefix "$1")"
shift
py_pybind11="$(abs_prefix "$1")"
shift
cmake="$(abs_prefix "$1")"
shift
ninja="$(abs_prefix "$1")"
shift
llvm="$(abs_prefix "$1")"
shift
nlohmann_json="$(abs_prefix "$1")"
shift
cuda="$(abs_prefix "$1")"
shift
zlib_ng="$(abs_prefix "$1")"
shift
compiler_prefix_map_flags=""
cuda_prefix_map_flags=""
for logical_map_root in $python $python_venv $py_pip $py_setuptools $py_wheel $py_filelock $py_lit $py_pybind11 $cmake $ninja $llvm $nlohmann_json $cuda $zlib_ng; do
  resolved_map_root="$(readlink -f "$logical_map_root" 2>/dev/null || printf "%s" "$logical_map_root")"
  for map_root in "$logical_map_root" "$resolved_map_root"; do
    compiler_prefix_map_flags="$compiler_prefix_map_flags -ffile-prefix-map=$map_root=. -fdebug-prefix-map=$map_root=. -fmacro-prefix-map=$map_root=."
    cuda_prefix_map_flags="$cuda_prefix_map_flags -Xcompiler=-ffile-prefix-map=$map_root=. -Xcompiler=-fdebug-prefix-map=$map_root=. -Xcompiler=-fmacro-prefix-map=$map_root=."
  done
done
mkdir -p "$(dirname "$env_file")" "{work}/home" "{work}/pip-cache"
cat > "$env_file" <<EOF
set -euo pipefail
export PIP_DISABLE_PIP_VERSION_CHECK=1
export PIP_NO_INDEX=1
export PIP_NO_INPUT=1
export PYTHONHOME=
export PYTHONNOUSERSITE=1
export TRITON_OFFLINE_BUILD=1
export CFLAGS="$CFLAGS $compiler_prefix_map_flags"
export CXXFLAGS="$CXXFLAGS $compiler_prefix_map_flags"
export CUDAFLAGS="$CUDAFLAGS $cuda_prefix_map_flags"
export NVCC_FLAGS="$NVCC_FLAGS $cuda_prefix_map_flags"
export TRITON_APPEND_CMAKE_ARGS="-DCMAKE_C_FLAGS='$CFLAGS $compiler_prefix_map_flags' -DCMAKE_CXX_FLAGS='$CXXFLAGS $compiler_prefix_map_flags' -DCMAKE_CUDA_FLAGS='$CUDAFLAGS $cuda_prefix_map_flags'"
export CMAKE_C_COMPILER="$CC"
export CMAKE_CXX_COMPILER="$CXX"
export LLVM_SYSPATH="$llvm"
export JSON_SYSPATH="$nlohmann_json"
export PYBIND11_SYSPATH="$py_pybind11"
export LIBRARY_PATH="$zlib_ng/lib"
export LDFLAGS="-L$zlib_ng/lib"
export TRITON_PTXAS_PATH="$cuda/bin/ptxas"
export TRITON_PTXAS_BLACKWELL_PATH="$cuda/bin/ptxas"
export TRITON_CUOBJDUMP_PATH="$cuda/bin/cuobjdump"
export TRITON_NVDISASM_PATH="$cuda/bin/nvdisasm"
export TRITON_CUDACRT_PATH="$cuda/include"
export TRITON_CUDART_PATH="$cuda/include"
export TRITON_CUPTI_PATH="$cuda"
export TRITON_CUPTI_INCLUDE_PATH="$cuda/include"
export TRITON_CUPTI_LIB_PATH="$cuda/lib64"
export TRITON_CUPTI_LIB_BLACKWELL_PATH="$cuda/lib64"
export TRITON_LIBDEVICE_PATH="$cuda/nvvm/libdevice/libdevice.10.bc"
export CUDA_HOME="$cuda"
export CUDA_PATH="$cuda"
export PYTHONPATH="$py_pip/lib/python3.13/site-packages:$py_setuptools/lib/python3.13/site-packages:$py_wheel/lib/python3.13/site-packages:$py_filelock/lib/python3.13/site-packages:$py_lit/lib/python3.13/site-packages:$py_pybind11/lib/python3.13/site-packages:$python_venv/lib/python3.13/site-packages"
export CMAKE_PREFIX_PATH="$python:$python_venv:$cmake:$ninja:$llvm:$nlohmann_json:$py_pybind11:$zlib_ng:$cuda"
export PATH="$python_venv/bin:$python/bin:$py_pip/bin:$py_wheel/bin:$py_lit/bin:$cmake/bin:$ninja/bin:$llvm/bin:$cuda/bin:/usr/bin:/bin"
export HOME="{work}/home"
export PIP_CACHE_DIR="{work}/pip-cache"
EOF
